# Code of Conduct

Everyone participating in System Ops spaces is expected to help create a respectful, welcoming community regardless of background, identity, experience, or ability.

## Expected behavior

Be considerate, use constructive feedback, respect different experiences, and accept corrections. Discuss technical decisions with evidence. Respect privacy and keep conversations relevant to the project.

Harassment, discriminatory language, threats, sexualized conduct, personal attacks, doxxing, and repeated disruption are unacceptable. These expectations apply to issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews, and other spaces representing the project.

## Reporting and enforcement

Contact maintainer [@dineshkorukonda](https://github.com/dineshkorukonda) through a private contact channel listed on their profile. Ask for a confidential channel if needed; do not publish sensitive details. Reports are treated confidentially to the extent practical. Maintainers involved in a report should recuse themselves where another independent reviewer is available; this small project cannot promise an independent appeals body.

Maintainers may edit/remove content, issue a warning, restrict participation temporarily, or ban participation depending on severity and repetition. They will explain decisions privately where practical. Retaliation against reporters is unacceptable.
